title: Calendar
intro: Add your Help dates to your calendar (Google, Outlook, Apple). The calendar updates by itself, usually every few hours.
warning: Anyone with this link sees your dates without signing in. Do not share it.
neverFetched: Your calendar has not fetched the link yet.
rotateText: The old link will stop working. Calendars that use it need the new one instead.
revokeText: The link will stop working. Help dates disappear from your calendar when it next updates (or when you remove the subscription in your calendar).
tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
